header.note_en: Written 60 + oral 30 = 90 marks. The oral part is taken by the teacher from the marking scheme.
header.note_ur: تحریری 60 + زبانی 30 = 90 نمبر۔ زبانی حصہ استاد مارکنگ اسکیم سے لیں گے۔

slots.prompt_rule: A word quoted in a «لفظ «…» کا مطلب» stem is spelled exactly as the book pages print it (v37r4 printed «بیسرا» for the book's «بسیرا»); copy it from the pages. Ten three-option MCQs on the words of the book lessons and poems. This section is words and grammar: meanings, opposites, singular and plural, verbs, the right spelling. No item asks a poet's name, who said what or what happened in a story (that is recall, and the comprehension section tests it), so poets never appear in this section. No answer or target word repeats another question's: the keyed word and the word asked about are never a keyed or asked word of any other question on this paper; a feminine or plural key that another question already keys is a repeat. A singular/plural MCQ never offers the oblique plural (…وں) as a distractor: «کھڑکیوں» beside «کھڑکیاں» makes two right answers.

slots.instruction_ur: الفاظ کو حروفِ تہجی کی ترتیب سے لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Four items of three book words out of order. Answer: the ordered words. The three words of an item begin with three different letters, so the order is never decided by the second letter (v35 «اونٹ، الو، مور» needed ل before و); use only letters whose order a Grade 2 child knows from the book chart.

Four book sentences with one blank; the four answers, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item. The box holds exactly the four keyed answers and no other word: every item's answer is one of the box words (v37r4 keyed «فوج» with «کلیاں» in the box).

slots.instruction_ur: جملوں میں سے فعل تلاش کر کے لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Four short book sentences. Answer: the verb. A sentence holds one verb form: never one with a converb («پہن کر») beside its main verb, since a child can name either, and never a compound verb of noun + verb (v35 «دلاسا دیا», where a child may write the whole phrase), so the answer is one word. `accept` holds the shorter form without the auxiliary («ہنس رہی» for «ہنس رہی ہے»). The sentence holds no noun that is also a verb form: «گانا», «کھانا», «پینا» used as nouns are infinitives, so a child may name them as the verb (v37 «بلبل گانا گائے گی» has two verbs to choose from); pick a sentence whose only verb form is the keyed one.

Four book nouns. Answer: the plural. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the given noun, one of it, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. No answer or target word repeats another question's: the keyed word and the word asked about are never a keyed or asked word of any other question on this paper; a feminine or plural key that another question already keys is a repeat. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

Four book words with a common opposite. Answer: the opposite. The `accept` list holds only a true opposite, and holds every other true opposite a Grade 2 child would write (اچھا: برا and خراب; a word with one opposite only needs that one); never a related word that is not an opposite. Prefer words whose opposite is one word.

slots.instruction_ur: تصویر دیکھ کر پانچ جملے لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: One busy scene from a book theme (a market, a park, a village) as picture: {kind:"scene", describe} in English for the artist. Its `question` is an empty string: the heading already gives the instruction. Answer: five model sentences, each about only what its own `describe` shows, with the same counts (two children means two, never one child), and never a colour (an outline drawing has none). Scheme: five K points of 2 — each a correct sentence about the picture. Each thing in the scene is one simple object or action that a drawing shows plainly (no animal pulling or carrying a load: a donkey with a cart and baskets was drawn with the baskets on its back and no cart), and each key sentence states only what the `describe` says. The `describe` never names a person, and shows exactly the number of people the key speaks of. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

slots.instruction_ur: دیے گئے موضوع پر پانچ جملے لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: One book topic (my school, my favourite fruit, our country). The heading says only «the given topic», so the topic goes in `question` as a short line such as «موضوع: میرا اسکول»; `question` is never empty and never repeats the heading. Answer: five model sentences. Scheme: five K points of 2 — each a correct sentence on topic.

slots.instruction_ur: دو دوستوں کے درمیان پانچ باتوں کا مکالمہ لکھیں۔ ہر بات سے پہلے بولنے والے کا نام لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Two friends planning something together (a game, a picnic); the stem names the plan and does not restate the instruction (the heading asks for five turns, each with the speaker's name before it). Answer: a model dialogue of five turns, each written «پہلا دوست: ... دوسرا دوست: ...». Scheme: five K points of 2, and each point pays the speaker's name: 1 for the name before the turn and 1 for the turn that fits the plan and the one before (the heading asks for the name, so a mark must pay it). The descriptors under each point match that header: 2 = the name and a correct sentence, 1 = one of the two, 0 = neither; never descriptors that score the sentence alone. The common error is not the only place the name appears. No accept: the points mark any dialogue on this plan.

lines_en: One mark per correct item unless the paper says otherwise.
Written marks only. Record the oral marks from the oral sheet, then add both on the class record.
